goal: The day page shows per-block confidence and the day's gaps, from the timeline helpers (USER-STORIES S7-S9).

items.desc: fish shell history collector. New module collectors/fish.rs, registered in collectors/mod.rs. Parse ~/.local/share/fish/fish_history (entries '- cmd: <text>' then '  when: <epoch>' and optional '  paths:' list). Track the working directory across entries from `cd <abs|~|relative>` commands. PRIVACY: never store the command text — title = the program name only (first token, e.g. `git`, `cargo`), details = None. project_path = the repo root when the tracked cwd or an absolute/~ path argument lies under ~/Desktop/Work/<key> or ~/Desktop/Projects/<key> (collapse /.claude/worktrees/* like billing::work_folder_for_path), else None. source = "shell", source_id = "<when>:<entry index>", upsert via repo::upsert_event (idempotent). Expose collect_from_path(conn, path, since, until) -> Result<CollectReport> for tests. Inline #[cfg(test)] tests with a temp fixture file: parses entries, keeps only since..until, cd tracking attributes a later `cargo test` to the repo, no command text stored, re-run inserts 0 new rows.
items.verify: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p worklog-core collectors::fish 2>&1 | grep -qE 'test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed'

items.desc: git reflog collector. New module collectors/reflog.rs, registered in collectors/mod.rs. For each repo directly under the given roots (default ~/Desktop/Work and ~/Desktop/Projects; a repo = dir with .git), read .git/logs/HEAD lines '<old> <new> <name> <<email>> <epoch> <tz>\t<message>'. Keep entries in since..until. source = "git_reflog", source_id = "<repo dir name>:<epoch>:<new sha>", started_at = epoch UTC, title = the action + target only (`checkout <branch>`, `commit`, `merge <branch>`, `rebase`, `pull`, `reset` — never the commit message body), project_path = the repo root. Read files only; never run the git CLI. Expose collect_from_roots(conn, roots, since, until). Inline tests with a temp dir holding two fake repos: parses both, filters by time, titles carry no commit message text, idempotent re-run.
items.verify: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p worklog-core collectors::reflog 2>&1 | grep -qE 'test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed'

items.desc: CLI wiring: add Shell and Reflog to CollectTarget in worklog-cli, dispatch to the L1/L2 collectors with default paths, and include both in `collect all`. Never print to stdout from hook-run. Add a unit test named collect_targets_include_shell_and_reflog asserting both variants parse from their CLI names (`shell`, `reflog`) and that `all` runs them (assert via the function that lists the targets `all` runs, extracting one if needed).
items.verify: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p worklog-cli collect_targets_include_shell_and_reflog 2>&1 | grep -qE 'test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed'

items.desc: Prove shell and git_reflog events join blocks: add infer tests shell_and_reflog_events_form_a_project_block (20 min of `shell` events every 2 min under ~/Desktop/Work/vitinn-infra plus one git_reflog checkout → one block with that project_path, 15–25 min) and reflog_checkout_switches_project (repo A shell events, then a git_reflog checkout in repo B at 10:14 followed by B shell events → A's block ends by 10:15 and a B block starts). Change infer.rs only if a test fails.
items.verify: out=$(cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p worklog-core infer::tests:: 2>&1); echo "$out" | grep -q 'shell_and_reflog_events_form_a_project_block ... ok' && echo "$out" | grep -q 'reflog_checkout_switches_project ... ok'

items.desc: New module timeline.rs (registered in lib.rs) with pure functions: block_confidence(distinct_sources: usize) -> &'static str ("high" for >=3, "medium" for 2, "low" for <=1) and day_gaps(blocks: &[(DateTime<Utc>, DateTime<Utc>)], min_gap: Duration) -> Vec<(DateTime<Utc>, DateTime<Utc>)> returning gaps >= min_gap between consecutive (sorted) blocks, overlap-safe. Inline tests: thresholds, a 45-min gap reported, a 10-min gap not reported at min 30, overlapping blocks produce no gap.
items.verify: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p worklog-core timeline:: 2>&1 | grep -qE 'test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed'

items.desc: Daemon: in daemon.rs stitch_day_summary, add `confidence: String` to each BlockSummary = timeline::block_confidence(number of distinct sources in that block's sources list), and add `gaps: Vec<DayGap>` to DaySummary where DayGap { started_at: String, ended_at: String, minutes: i64 } comes from timeline::day_gaps over the day's block intervals with min_gap 30 minutes (RFC3339 UTC strings like the blocks use). Add a daemon test named day_summary_reports_block_confidence_and_gaps: two blocks 45 minutes apart, one with events from 3 sources (expect "high") and one with 1 source (expect "low"), and exactly one gap of 45 minutes. Keep the change minimal: daemon.rs is already very large; do not refactor it.
items.verify: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p worklog-core day_summary_reports_block_confidence_and_gaps 2>&1 | grep -qE 'test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed'

items.desc: Web: mirror the new fields in web/lib/types.ts (BlockSummary.confidence: 'high'|'medium'|'low'; DaySummary.gaps: {started_at, ended_at, minutes}[]). BlockCard shows a small confidence badge with visible text (e.g. 'high confidence') and an aria-label; the day page lists each gap between blocks as a muted row 'No activity HH:MM–HH:MM (N min)' in local time, and gaps add 0 minutes to any total. Add bun tests: web/components/BlockCard.test.tsx asserts the badge text for each level, and a gap-row test asserts the row text. Run `cd web && bun test && bun run typecheck`. Never run `bun run build`.
